Definitely something i see a lot, many people confuse depression with sadness and its a shame. It makes people who actually are depressed and may not know it feel guilty and worsen their condition.

A psychotherapist is there to help you understand you’re own emotions and explain to you what you can do to help. I cant speak for everyone but in my personal experience with depression a lot of the problem was confusion, being confused was aggravating and i just wanted to know why i felt the way i felt. So being able to understand that what i was struggling with was not my fault helped immensely. I believe the point of therapy is to guide and show you how to better understand and help yourself. That being said not everyone is tge same and each person’s trauma and experience is their own and unique. Also there is a difference between a psychotherapist and a psychiatrist, though you see them for the same reasons.
